en: I know I have made mistakes.
zh: 我知道自己犯过错。

en: The wrong choices I made--
zh: 我做出了错误的选择——

en: I thought the blood in my veins somehow made them right.
zh: 却以为凭着体内的血统，就能证明它们是对的。

en: Words will not let me take any of it back. But I want to atone through action. I want to give my life for my people!
zh: 言语无法挽回这一切。但我要以行动赎罪，要为百姓献出生命！

en: How delightfully amusing.
zh: 真是有趣极了。

en: You man-creatures choose to live free of the other races?
zh: 你们这些人类，选择摆脱其他种族，独自生活？

en: Unwise... but no matter.
zh: 不明智……不过无妨。

en: We shall soon see what value， if any， you humans possess.
zh: 我们很快就会知道，你们人类究竟有几分价值。

en: You are concerned for your people. I understand.
zh: 你们牵挂着百姓。我明白。

en: Very well. The Earthblood will trouble you no longer.
zh: 好吧。地界人不会再打扰你们。

en: Just remember: you are not alone in this world. One day， like it or not， you will have to join the greater conflict.
zh: 只须记住：这个世界并非只有你们。终有一天，无论情愿与否，你们都得卷入更大的纷争。

en: Yes， you seem ready.
zh: 不错，你们似乎已经准备好了。

en: It is time you learned of the workings of the world.
zh: 是时候让你们了解世界的运作方式了。

en: We dwell in， essentially， a laboratory--where a supreme Creator is testing us.
zh: 我们所处的地方，本质上是一间实验室……至高的造物主在这里考验我们。

en: He seeks the ultimate warrior， one he can claim for himself.
zh: 他在寻找终极战士，一个能为他所用的战士。

en: The Skyborn are his servants; we， the Earthblood， are the warrior candidates whom the Creator rejected.
zh: 天界人是他的仆从；而我们地界人，则是被造物主淘汰的战士候选者。

en: But humans--what are you? You too must have some role， some destiny. Would you like to know what that is?
zh: 可人类呢？你们究竟是什么？你们也必有自己的职责与命运。想知道答案吗？

en: The answers lie just ahead!
zh: 答案就在前方！

en: THE MASTER'S PLANS MUST BE EXECUTED AT ALL COSTS. YOU CANNOT STOP ME， HUMANS.
zh: 必须不惜一切执行主人的计划。人类，你们无法阻止我。

en: YOUR EMOTIONS PREVENT YOU FROM MAKING LOGICAL CHOICES.
zh: 你们的情感，妨碍了合乎逻辑的选择。

en: You cowardly scoundrel! Release Princess Lucia!
zh: 卑鄙的懦夫！放开露西亚公主！

en: Lucia!
zh: 露西亚！

en: What do you want with her!?
zh: 你抓她做什么！？

en: Hey! I thought you were tough! What kind of tough guy hides behind an innocent hostage!?
zh: 喂！你不是很厉害吗？躲在无辜人质后面，算哪门子的硬汉！？

en: You craven abomination! You are no warrior if you use an innocent woman as a shield!
zh: 怯懦的怪物！以无辜女子为盾，你根本不配称作战士！

en: Wow! A damsel in distress! Wanna trade places?
zh: 哇！遇难的少女！咱们换个位置好不好？

en: Strike him down!
zh: 打倒他！

en: I am not afraid to die. I stood by and let Kanon terrorize our people with his kingdom of magic!
zh: 我不怕死。我曾袖手旁观，任由卡农用他的魔法国度恐吓百姓！

en: Now I must atone.
zh: 如今，我必须赎罪。

en: Ha! Hollow hunks of metal! I will take care of things here.
zh: 哈！不过是一堆空心废铁！这里交给我。

en: Your concern is with these “Earthblood“ and “Skyborn，“ whatever they are. Now go!
zh: 你们的目标是那些“地界人”和“天界人”，管它们是什么。快走！

en: You man-creatures have turned on both of the higher races?
zh: 你们这些人类，同时与两个高等种族为敌？

en: Unwise， but no matter. We shall soon see what value， if any， you humans possess.
zh: 不明智，不过无妨。我们很快就会知道，你们究竟有几分价值。

en: YOU SEE? I HAVE WON. COME， PRINCESS. YOU ARE A VALUABLE ASSET.
zh: 看到了吗？我赢了。公主，走吧。你是重要的资源。

en: Lucia is innocent! Does her life mean nothing to you?
zh: 露西亚是无辜的！她的生命，在你们眼里就一文不值吗？

en: I will never forgive this!
zh: 我永远不会原谅你们！

en: I can understand your hatred for a monarchy that deceives and tramples your people.
zh: 王室欺骗百姓，将他们踩在脚下。你们痛恨它，我理解。

en: But you need to consider Kanon's reasons--the source of his own hatred.
zh: 但你们也该想想卡农的理由……他仇恨的根源。

en: All of our sorrow and pain can be traced to those Skyborn fiends who stare down at us coldly from the heavens.
zh: 我们所有的悲伤与苦痛，都源于那些在云端冷眼俯视我们的天界人恶鬼。

en: You have grown strong， humans. You are ready.
zh: 人类，你们已经变强了。时机已到。

en: It is time you learned of  the workings of the world.
zh: 是时候让你们了解世界的运作方式了。

en: We dwell in， essentially， a laboratory--where a supreme Creator is testing us. He seeks the ultimate warrior， one he can claim for himself.
zh: 我们所处的地方，本质上是一间实验室……至高的造物主在这里考验我们。他在寻找终极战士，一个能为他所用的战士。

en: But humans--what are you? Your role， your destiny is not yet set in stone. Fight now， and you could yet break free.
zh: 可人类呢？你们究竟是什么？你们的职责与命运，尚未定下。现在战斗，或许仍能挣脱束缚。

en: The world could be rewrought!
zh: 世界，也可以重塑！

en: King Valgar is a demon? How could I not have seen it?
zh: 瓦尔加国王是恶魔？我怎会一直没发现？

en: If what we just heard is true， we must face these Skyborn!
zh: 若刚才听到的都是真的，我们就必须面对天界人！

en: King Valgar is a demon? That's nuts!
zh: 瓦尔加国王是恶魔？太离谱了！

en: But it sounds like we need to have a word with the Skyborn.
zh: 不过听起来，我们得找天界人谈谈。

en: Are you seeing this， guys? King Valgar is a demon!
zh: 伙计们，看见了吗？瓦尔加国王是恶魔！

en: Hmm， seems like the Skyborn are who we're really after.
zh: 嗯，看来天界人才是我们真正要找的。

en: Do my eyes deceive me? The king is a demon!
zh: 我没看错吧？国王竟是恶魔！

en: This Earthblood seems to wish us no harm. Perhaps the Skyborn truly are to blame!
zh: 这位地界人似乎无意害我们。或许罪魁祸首，当真是天界人！

en: So， the king's a demon? Okay.
zh: 所以，国王是恶魔？好吧。

en: Let's just roll with that and go see these Skyborn!
zh: 那就这么着吧，去见见那些天界人！

en: Welcome， warriors. You were wise to come here in search of truth.
zh: 欢迎，战士们。来这里寻找真相，是明智之举。

en: It it time you learned of the workings of the world.
zh: 是时候让你们了解世界的运作方式了。

en: I rule over the Earthblood， one of three races.
zh: 我统治着三个种族之一的地界人。

en: But humans--what are you? Your role， your destiny is not clear to me. Do you have the courage to go find out?
zh: 可人类呢？你们究竟是什么？你们的职责与命运，连我也不清楚。你们有勇气寻找答案吗？

en: The choice is yours.
zh: 选择权在你们手中。

en: As you wish， then.
zh: 那么，如你们所愿。

en: The black wizard's plans remain in motion. Perhaps you can still stop his mechanical creations from seizing power.
zh: 黑魔法师的计划仍在推进。或许，你们还能阻止他的机械造物夺取统治权。

en: Very well! I will open the way to the heavens for you.
zh: 好！我会为你们打开通往天界的道路。

en: Go now， and learn the truth of what you humans are!
zh: 去吧，弄清你们人类的真正身份！

en: I misjudged you. And now， here we stand， left with but one way to resolve this.
zh: 我看错了你们。事已至此，我们之间只剩一种解决方式。

en: We no longer need you man- creatures to shelter us while we nurse ourselves back to full strength. We are ready to destroy the Skyborn!
zh: 我们已不再需要人类庇护，来慢慢恢复力量。现在，我们已能消灭天界人！

en: But you， foolish ones， shall be the first to incur my wrath!
zh: 但首先，就让你们这些蠢货承受我的怒火！

en: Now that you are archenemies of the Earthblood， I will say only this--
zh: 既然你们已成地界人的死敌，我就只说一句——

en: The tyrant must be pleased. Today， you rid him of his greatest threat， and also ended his search. Fools...
zh: 那位暴君想必很高兴。今日，你们为他除去了最大的威胁，也让他找到了苦寻之物。蠢货……

en: I commend you， white warriors， on behalf of our Lord. You have surpassed even his greatest expectations.
zh: 白之战士们，我代表吾主嘉奖你们。你们甚至超越了他最好的预期。

en: There is another we owe thanks. Come forward， ye dead warrior. You have performed admirably as our messenger. Sleep， now， and be troubled no more.
zh: 还有一位，我们也应感谢。死去的战士，上前来。身为我们的使者，你做得很好。现在安眠吧，不必再受困扰。

en: We Skyborn hope your valiant actions serve as an example. Yours was a strong and noble race before you succumbed to the darker side of magic.
zh: 我们天界人，希望你们的英勇事迹能成为榜样。在沉沦于魔法的黑暗面之前，你们曾是强大而高贵的种族。

en: We were wrong to give you such a dangerous power， and will meddle with your world no more.
zh: 将如此危险的力量赐予你们，是我们的过错。我们不会再干涉你们的世界。

en: What skill! We never dreamed you had so much potential.
zh: 好身手！真没想到，你们竟有如此潜力。

en: You no longer need guidance.
zh: 你们已不再需要指引。

en: Had we known you humans had such bloodlust... You will make such powerful servants of our Lord!
zh: 早知你们人类如此嗜血……你们一定能成为吾主强大的仆从！

en: What? Reservations about joining us on high? Nonsense. You have earned a place there.
zh: 什么？不愿与我们一同升天？荒唐。你们已赢得那里的一席之地。

en: And seeing as you are our finest champions， our Lord will quite insist you take it.
zh: 而且，身为我们最优秀的战士，吾主一定会要求你们接受。

en: Ha ha ha! What vicious little darlings you are!
zh: 哈哈哈！你们真是一群凶残的小可爱！

en: You are like itches in the small of my back: maddeningly unpleasant， except for that last moment of bliss--when you finally get SCRATCHED!
zh: 你们就像我后腰上的痒处：烦得要命，唯一痛快的时刻……就是终于把你们挠掉！

en: Aloha， chumps! Welcome to this story's dramatic finale!
zh: 你们好啊，蠢货！欢迎来到本故事激动人心的大结局！

en: All I have to do is mangle you twerps， and I'll be a national hero! Lord Zur does what the Black Ordoesn't!
zh: 只要把你们几个小鬼打烂，我就是国家英雄！黑之骑士团办不成的，祖尔大人来办！

en: Ouch! Okay， okay.
zh: 哎哟！好啦好啦。

en: I admit it， I'm a loser. Why don't we just team up?
zh: 我承认，我是个废物。不如我们联手吧？

en: We could kill Valgar and be kings! Sweet deal， am I right?
zh: 杀掉瓦尔加，我们一起当国王！这买卖不错吧？

en: That's it. We need to settle this， once and for all.
zh: 够了。这件事，该彻底了结了。

en: Valgar! Thank goodness!
zh: 瓦尔加！谢天谢地！

en: Get those wimps!
zh: 快收拾这些废物！

en: I'd do it myself， but I， uh， I left my spine in the car! Better go get it!
zh: 本来该我亲自动手，可我，呃，把胆子落车里了！我得去拿！

en: Zur， you gutless vampire. All you know how to do is claw your way up people's backs in your quest for power.
zh: 祖尔，你这没骨气的吸血虫。除了踩着别人的后背往上爬、争权夺利，你还会做什么？

en: The world has no use for you.
zh: 这个世界不需要你。

en: Begone!
zh: 滚吧！

en: HahahahahahahahaHAHAHAHAHA!
zh: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

en: Vampire? Tsk， tsk， TSK.
zh: 吸血虫？啧，啧，啧。

en: What's wrong with digging in your claws now and then?
zh: 偶尔伸伸爪子，有什么不对？

en: You call that bloodsucking.
zh: 你说我吸别人的血。

en: I call it NOT SUCKING!
zh: 我说这叫有本事！

en: But thank you， Valgar!
zh: 不过，谢谢你，瓦尔加！

en: The magic power you gave me--
zh: 你赐给我的魔力——

en: makes me feel like a NEW MAN!
zh: 让我脱胎换骨了！

en: I'm bursting at the BRAINS--
zh: 我的脑瓜都快胀裂了——

en: I'm an inedible HULK--
zh: 我变成了无敌的大块头——

en: and you're about to learn--
zh: 现在就让你们见识——

en: how SUPER Lord Zur really is!
zh: 祖尔大人到底有多么超级！

en: Behold! A new hero... is
zh: 看啊！一位全新的英雄……就此

en: boooooooo
zh: 诞

en: oooooooo
OOORR
zh: 生

en: RRRRrrrrr
rrrrrrrrrr
nnnnnnn
zh: 啦

en: nnNNnnNN
nnnnn
NNNNNNN
nnn
NNNnnn!
I just gotta ask: what kind of cosmic disaster causes people like that to exist?
zh: 我就想问问：到底是什么宇宙大灾难，才生出这种人？

en: At least we can take comfort in knowing his dark， er， reign has come to an end. The impostors are no more and the kingdom is safe!
zh: 至少，他那黑暗的，呃，统治终于结束了，也算是个安慰。冒牌货已被铲除，王国安全了！

en: Hmm...
Do you ever wonder if we went about this the wrong way?
zh: 你们可曾想过，我们是不是走错了路？

en: We made an enemy of Valgar， but I realize now that even he acted out of a sort of love. He had the kingdom's best interest in mind.
zh: 我们与瓦尔加为敌，可我如今明白，他的所作所为，也出于某种爱。他心里想的是王国的利益。

en: Poor guy.
zh: 可怜的家伙。

en: He didn't do things the smart way， but maybe you're right. He was just trying to reach out to his subjects.
zh: 他办事是挺蠢的，可也许你说得对。他只是想与百姓亲近。

en: Well， um， then that means...
zh: 那，呃，这么说……

en: Valgar's legacy is us. We have to carry on for him.
zh: 瓦尔加留下的希望，就是我们。我们得替他继续走下去。

en: Yes， you're right.
zh: 是的，你说得对。

en: He was bad at showing it，
zh: 他不懂得表达，

en: but I believe that all Valgar wanted was an age of peace.
zh: 但我相信，瓦尔加想要的，只是一个和平的时代。

en: Yet we took so many lives. Did we truly act in the best interests of the land?
zh: 可我们也夺去了太多生命。我们所做的一切，真的有益于这片土地吗？

en: Good point. Kanon and his regime killed people， but...
zh: 说得对。卡农和他的爪牙杀了人，可是……

en: What's our body count now?
zh: 我们又杀了多少人？

en: Han! Geez! You can't think of it like that!
zh: 哈恩！真是的！不能这么想！

en: We're the good guys! Why else would the resistance and everybody else side with us?
zh: 我们是好人啊！不然反抗军和大家为什么都站在我们这边？

en: I hope you are right， Randy.
zh: 兰迪，但愿你是对的。

en: Too many people died for us to squander this victory.
zh: 牺牲的人太多了，我们不能辜负这场胜利。

en: Let us swear here and now that tomorrow will bring peace.
zh: 就在此刻立下誓言，愿明日迎来和平。

en: I applaud your courage， man-creatures.
zh: 人类，我赞赏你们的勇气。

en: But vengeance upon the Skyborn belongs to US.
zh: 但向天界人复仇，是我们的事。

en: Do not interfere!
zh: 不许插手！

en: Humans， you have grown strong. Perhaps you were meant to slay the Skyborn， not us Earthblood.
zh: 人类，你们已经变得强大。或许你们注定要杀的，是天界人，而非我们地界人。

en: But humans--what are you? Your role， your destiny is not yet set in stone. Fight now， and you could yet break free! You may， in fact， free us all.
zh: 可人类呢？你们究竟是什么？你们的职责与命运，尚未定下。现在战斗，或许仍能挣脱束缚！甚至，解放我们所有人。

en: I know I can never win your respect. But I love my kingdom all the same. Let me fight at your side!
zh: 我知道，我永远也赢不来你们的尊重。但我仍深爱我的王国。让我与你们并肩作战！

en: Valgar?
zh: 瓦尔加？

en: Then protect Princess Lucia!
zh: 那就保护好露西亚公主！

en: We'll stop that iron menace!
zh: 我们去阻止那个钢铁怪物！

en: Works for me!
zh: 我没意见！

en: Get Lucia out of here.
zh: 带露西亚离开这里。

en: I've got some metal to crunch.
zh: 我要去砸几块铁。

en: Valgar!?
zh: 瓦尔加！？

en: Fine. You handle things here. I'm going after Silver!
zh: 好，这里交给你。我去追希尔弗！

en: That gussied-up garbage can  is getting on my nerves!
zh: 那个花里胡哨的垃圾桶，真把我惹烦了！

en: The black knight... Very well. May you be stronger as ally than adversary!
zh: 黑骑士……好吧。但愿你当盟友时，比当敌人更强！

en: Keep your sister safe.
zh: 保护好你妹妹。

en: Whoa. Really!?
zh: 哇，真的！？

en: That's so sweet! Watch your sister then， 'kay?
zh: 太贴心了！那就照看好你妹妹，好吗？

en: THE MASTER'S PLANS MUST BE EXECUTED AT ALL COSTS.
zh: 必须不惜一切执行主人的计划。

en: THEREFORE， I WILL EXPLOIT THE WEAKNESS OF THE HUMAN HEART.
zh: 因此，我将利用人心的弱点。

en: You craven scoundrel! Let Princess Lucia go!
zh: 卑鄙的懦夫！放开露西亚公主！

en: Lucia! Have you lost your mind?
zh: 露西亚！你疯了吗？

en: She's your princess!
zh: 她可是你们的公主！

en: What? I thought you were tough! Tough guys don't hide behind hostages!
zh: 什么？你不是很厉害吗？硬汉才不会躲在人质后面！

en: Princess! Grr， the metal apple  never falls far from the tree.
zh: 公主！可恶，有什么样的铁主子，就有什么样的铁奴才。

en: Wow! A damsel in distress! Boys are gonna be falling all over her! (If she lives...)
zh: 哇！遇难的少女！男孩子肯定要为她争破头了！（前提是她能活下来……）

en: I am not afraid to die.
zh: 我不怕死。

en: I stood by and let Kanon terrorize our people with his kingdom of magic!
zh: 我曾袖手旁观，任由卡农用他的魔法国度恐吓百姓！

en: How it must sadden our Lord that you， his Chosen， have walked this sorrowful path.
zh: 你们身为吾主的天选之人，却走上如此可悲的道路，吾主定会深感痛心。

en: Explain yourself.
zh: 把话说清楚。

en: Somebody chose us?
zh: 有人选中了我们？

en: Who!?
Um， Chosen?
zh: 呃，天选之人？

en: You must have the wrong guys.
zh: 你们找错人了吧。

en: Chosen?
zh: 天选之人？

en: Don't be absurd. We choose for ourselves.
zh: 荒唐。我们自己的路，自己选。

en: Chosen? Really?
zh: 天选之人？真的？

en: Cool! What do I win?
zh: 太好了！奖品是什么？

en: Do you really believe these events that befell you were an accident?
zh: 你们真以为，这一路遭遇的一切都是巧合？

en: That through your own skill you found that sword， and its wielder's resting place?
zh: 以为凭自己的本事，找到了那把剑，找到了持剑者长眠的地方？

en: Ha ha! That you are so mighty you can level armies and dethrone great rulers?
zh: 哈！以为自己当真强大到能击溃大军、推翻君王？

en: No. All of this was wrought by the powers we concealed in the sword--a divine calling.
zh: 不。这一切，都是我们藏在剑中的力量所为……是神的召唤。

en: You were part of our plan. We chose you from among the scraps of humanity to be the lucky few we would craft into our ultimate warriors.
zh: 你们本就是计划的一部分。我们从芸芸众生中挑出你们这少数幸运儿，要将你们塑造成终极战士。

en: The golden one who led you here was our messenger.
zh: 那位带你们来到此地的金色战士，正是我们的使者。

en: But our Lord sorely misjudged you， and our messenger has betrayed us. Not one of you is worthy of his grace.
zh: 但吾主错看了你们，我们的使者也背叛了我们。你们没有一个，配得上他的恩典。

en: In his name， I shall scatter you all to the wind!
zh: 以他的名义，我将让你们全都灰飞烟灭！

en: Alas， I chose unwisely.
zh: 唉，我选错了。

en: As my ultimate warriors， you were to be my greatest creation.
zh: 身为我的终极战士，你们本该是我最伟大的杰作。

en: But no matter. I scoured the scraps of humanity， and found another diamond in the rough.
zh: 不过无妨。我遍寻芸芸众生，又发现了一块璞玉。

en: The despair in his heart once threatened to break him， but he has found hope in power. By walking the path I set before him， he has been saved.
zh: 心中的绝望曾几乎将他摧垮，但他在力量中找到了希望。踏上我指引的道路，他已得到救赎。

en: Come forth， my white warrior! Smite these infidels， and that disloyal pile of bones at their side!
zh: 现身吧，我的白之战士！击溃这些异端，还有他们身旁那堆不忠的骸骨！

en: Impossible!
zh: 不可能！

en: Valgar， a champion of light?
zh: 瓦尔加，竟成了光明的战士？

en: Valgar? Didn't see that coming.
zh: 瓦尔加？这我可真没想到。

en: Um... what?
zh: 呃……什么？

en: So， revealing Valgar's past has led him to an even more uncertain future.
zh: 这么说，揭露瓦尔加的过去，却把他引向了更加莫测的未来。

en: Why him!? I was cooperating! Mostly... Okay， not really.
zh: 为什么选他！？我明明很配合！大部分时候……好吧，其实也没有。

en: It shouldn't be like this.
zh: 事情不该变成这样。

en: But I was miserable! I had nothing left!
zh: 可我太痛苦了！我已经一无所有！

en: When he offered me power， It gave me something to cling to--a new identity.
zh: 当他赐给我力量时，我终于找到了寄托……一个全新的身份。

en: That is right. You are special. My chosen!
zh: 没错。你是特别的，是我的天选之人！

en: Now do exactly as I say. Our adversaries stand before us. Strike them down!
zh: 现在，完全照我说的做。敌人就在眼前，击溃他们！

en: No! You will not command me!
zh: 不！你休想命令我！

en: How is this any different from before?
zh: 这与从前又有什么区别？

en: The world is better off without you. No more gods and monsters--and no more puppets!
zh: 没有你，世界会更好。不再有神与怪物……也不再有傀儡！

en: Valgar， no! What are you--
zh: 瓦尔加，不！你要——

en: Hold it! What are you doing!?
zh: 住手！你在干什么！？

en: Wait. Valgar， don't!
zh: 等等，瓦尔加，不要！

en: Stop! You mustn't!
zh: 住手！万万不可！

en: Hey， no， don't!
zh: 喂，不，别这样！

en: Our Lord is wroth that his Chosen have taken so long to arrive at their destiny.
zh: 天选之人竟迟迟不肯迎接命运，吾主已然震怒。

en: Chosen? What do you mean?
zh: 天选之人？什么意思？

en: Chosen? What are you talking about?
zh: 天选之人？你在说什么？

en: Chosen? For what?
zh: 天选之人？选来做什么？

en: We choose for ourselves， as all men must.
zh: 我们的路，由我们自己选择。人人都该如此。

en: I'm a Chosen? Well， you didn't TELL ME!
zh: 我是天选之人？可你们根本没告诉我！

en: You are part of our plan. We chose you from among the scraps of humanity as the lucky few we would craft into our ultimate warriors.
zh: 你们本就是计划的一部分。我们从芸芸众生中挑出你们这少数幸运儿，要将你们塑造成终极战士。

en: The golden one who led you here is our messenger.
zh: 那位带你们来到此地的金色战士，正是我们的使者。

en: Now， fight me! Show our Lord the fruits of his labor!
zh: 现在，与我一战！让吾主看看他的心血结出了什么成果！

en: Hear ye， warriors!
zh: 战士们，听令！

en: I have judged you worthy.
zh: 我已判定，你们足够资格。

en: Now， come into my presence.
zh: 现在，到我面前来。

en: Ha ha ha! Is this the finest humanity can produce? We were cruel to say any of you could become the ultimate warrior.
zh: 哈哈哈！这就是人类能培养出的最强者？说你们也能成为终极战士，实在残忍。

en: HE STANDS BEFORE YOU!
zh: 真正的终极战士，就在你们面前！

en: Guys， are we， like， getting kidnapped?
zh: 伙计们，我们这是……被绑架了吗？

en: That's not funny. I want to go home!
zh: 这可不好笑。我想回家！

en: Brave warrior who died to keep my family safe， I ask you: is this what you wanted? Did you really return to us because you served some higher power?
zh: 为保护我家族而牺牲的勇士，我问你：这就是你的心愿吗？你重返人世，当真只是为了侍奉更高的存在？

en: I do not know your face or even your name. But I wanted to believe you served us， the people.  That you were our friend.
zh: 我不知道你的容貌，甚至不知道你的名字。但我愿意相信，你守护的是我们，是百姓。你是我们的朋友。

en: Wh-What treachery is this! You dare strike your Lord!?
zh: 这、这是何等背叛！你竟敢对自己的主人动手！？

en: You have no heart， no friends. You cannot be doing this!
zh: 你没有心，也没有朋友。你不可能这么做！

en: Oh， he's doing it.
zh: 可他已经动手了。

en: Some things just matter more than divine calling.
zh: 总有些东西，比神的召唤更重要。

en: We fought because we love our country. Not for you!
zh: 我们是为热爱的国家而战，才不是为了你！

en: This is madness! I have honored you by making you my sword and shield!
zh: 简直疯了！我赐予你们荣耀，让你们成为我的剑与盾！

en: You gained that power under my guidance!
zh: 你们的力量，都是在我的引导下获得的！

en: Paradise is already yours. You need only follow me!
zh: 乐园已属于你们。只需追随我就够了！

en: We will not. You have misjudged us!
zh: 我们不会追随你。你看错我们了！

en: We choose to be free! To decide our own destiny!
zh: 我们选择自由！选择自己决定命运！

en: You see this as defiance?
zh: 你觉得这是忤逆？

en: We see it as duty. If we follow you， the world below will be left in shambles.
zh: 我们认为，这是责任。如果追随你，下界就只剩一片废墟。

en: We refuse to accept paradise and condemn others to ruin!
zh: 我们绝不接受让他人毁灭、换自己进入乐园！

en: Fools! I made the world below!
zh: 蠢货！下界是我创造的！

en: It will stay forever in shambles， unless I right it!
zh: 除非由我来纠正，否则它永远只会是一片废墟！

en: That's your concern no longer!
zh: 那已不再由你操心！

en: ANALYSIS HAS DETERMINED HUMANS CANNOT SURVIVE UNDER THEIR OWN REGIME.
zh: 分析结果：人类无法在自己的统治下生存。

en: NOW THAT THE MASTER IS GONE， THE CODIFICATION OF HUMANITY FALLS ON OUR SHOULDERS.
zh: 主人已不在，规范人类秩序的职责，将由我们承担。

en: What has Kanon done?
zh: 卡农到底干了什么？

en: We will never submit to your wicked administration. Never!
zh: 我们绝不会屈服于你们的邪恶统治。绝不！

en: And now that my PATIENCE is gone， I'm gonna hit you. Hard!
zh: 现在，我的耐心也不在了。我要揍你，狠狠地揍！

en: What's that， tin face?
zh: 铁皮脸，你说什么呢？

en: Sorry. I don't speak junk-ese!
zh: 抱歉，我听不懂废铁语！

en: Ah! A wordsmith. Then quail， you querulous quack， while I quickly deliver the quietus!
zh: 啊！舞文弄墨之辈。那就颤抖吧，聒噪的庸才，我即刻赐你永恒的寂静！

en: “Codification“? Why you!
zh: “鳕鱼化”？好啊你！

en: Nobody turns Nicoley into a fish!
zh: 谁也别想把小妮可变成鱼！

en: That should put an end to Kanon's dreadful ambitions. Thank you.
zh: 这下，卡农可怕的野心终于结束了。谢谢你们。

en: It's finally over.
zh: 终于结束了。

en: Lucia， where is your brother?
zh: 露西亚，你哥哥在哪儿？

en: That's right. You and the kingdom are safe.
zh: 没错，你和王国都安全了。

en: Hey， where's your brother?
zh: 对了，你哥哥呢？

en: All in a day's work!
zh: 小事一桩！

en: Hey， what ever happened to your brother?
zh: 哎，你哥哥后来怎么样了？

en: May history never forget.
zh: 愿历史铭记今日。

en: Is your brother with you?
zh: 你哥哥和你在一起吗？

en: You're welcome!
zh: 不客气！

en: What happened to your brother?
zh: 你哥哥怎么样了？

en: Valgar left. He said a higher power still threatened the land， and that he must rise up against it.
zh: 瓦尔加走了。他说，还有更高的力量威胁着这片土地，他必须起身反抗。

en: But that is his fight.
zh: 但那是他的战斗。

en: Will you stay here and help me rebuild the kingdom? I will accept any punishment--
zh: 你们愿意留下来，帮我重建王国吗？我愿接受任何惩罚——

en: I only ask that you give the people the peace they deserve.
zh: 只求你们，让百姓得到应有的和平。

en: Of course. And Lucia... the age of punishment and vengeance has ended.
zh: 当然。露西亚……惩罚与复仇的时代，已经结束了。

en: Stability will return to this kingdom when we， those who love it， work together.
zh: 只要我们这些深爱王国的人齐心协力，王国就能恢复安定。

en: Let this next age be one of peace， and wisdom.
zh: 愿下一个时代，充满和平与智慧。

en: We have such a long road ahead to peace.
zh: 通往和平的路，还很漫长。

en: I can only wonder: have we done right by the world? All this killing... How are we different from Kanon?
zh: 我不禁在想：我们真的为世界做了正确的事吗？杀了那么多人……我们与卡农有何区别？

en: Perhaps we aren't. Not yet. Only the future can tell. We must honor those lives we had to take， by honoring the wishes of our countrymen who still remain.
zh: 或许并无区别，至少现在没有。唯有未来能给出答案。我们必须尊重仍然活着的同胞的心愿，来告慰那些不得不夺去的生命。

en: Let this next age be for them.
zh: 愿下一个时代，属于他们。

en: Gwaaaaaar!
zh: 嘎啊啊啊！

en: Mwaaaaaarg!
zh: 呜啊啊啊！

en: Yaaaaaarg!
zh: 呀啊啊啊！

en: Waaaaaaugh!
zh: 哇啊啊啊！

en: On the battlefield， crowns and titles mean nothing. The only real distinction is not dying， and you've distinctly failed at that.
zh: 战场上，王冠与头衔毫无意义。唯一重要的是活下来，而你显然没做到。

en: Rise! Perhaps， someday， you may be worthy of knighthood. Just not today!
zh: 起来！或许终有一天，你能配得上骑士之名。但绝不是今天！

en: Let today's victory be the first step toward tomorrow's!
zh: 愿今日的胜利，成为明日胜利的第一步！

en: Thank you， friends. I could never have triumphed alone.
zh: 谢谢你们，朋友。单凭我一人，绝无胜算。

en: I'm sure glad I didn't use my good sword!
zh: 幸好没动用我的好剑！

en: Picking fights with heroes? Not a good idea.
zh: 找英雄打架？这主意可不明智。

en: You know， you really-- what's the word--suck.
zh: 你知道吗，你真是……那词怎么说来着……烂透了。

en: I sense we have a strong team.
zh: 看来，我们这支队伍很强。

en: Not bad for a little shepherd boy， huh?
zh: 一个放羊的小子，能打成这样不错吧？

en: Whew! That was close. I thought my staff was gonna break from juggling you like that!
zh: 呼！真险。把你颠来颠去，我都怕法杖折了！

en: Gee， you think we were too hard on them?
zh: 呃，咱们是不是下手太重了？

en: Don't make me throw my bunny at you!
zh: 别逼我扔兔子砸你！

en: Tell my opponent I want my throwing stars returned as soon as possible.
zh: 转告我的对手，尽快归还我的手里剑。

en: Another battle， another victory!
zh: 再战一场，再添一胜！

en: Today's wisdom: a prepared sandwich mustards great power!
zh: 今日箴言：准备充分的三明治，芥末威力无穷！

en: My clan teaches that the brittle twig is first to snap.
zh: 族中有训：脆弱的枝条，最先折断。

en: I'd just like to take a moment to thank my staff.
zh: 请容我花一点时间，感谢我的法杖。

en: You just lost to a girl with a happy face around her neck. How weak are you?
zh: 你居然输给一个脖子上挂着笑脸的小姑娘。你得多弱啊？

en: Service with a smile!
zh: 微笑服务！

en: I guess I could stick around and heal the losers， but-- SHOPPING!
zh: 我本来可以留下来，治治这些输家，不过……我要购物去啦！

en: You can't hit what you can't catch!
zh: 追都追不上，还想打中我？

en: That's not all we rabbits are good at!
zh: 我们兔子擅长的可不止这些！

en: See? Having a rabbit on your side IS good luck!
zh: 看吧？有只兔子当队友，果然有好运！

en: As you know， there are winners and there are losers. The winners know it. The losers feel it!
zh: 世上有赢家，也有输家。赢家心里知道，输家身上知道！

en: It doesn't always pay to fight fair.
zh: 公平打架，不一定划算。

en: This sword is thicker and manlier than my old one!
zh: 这把剑比旧的更厚实，更有男子气概！

en: Now this right HERE is what I call a Sword of Legend!
zh: 这才叫真正的传说之剑！

en: Be honest， did I kill you with the sword or with my impossibly good looks?
zh: 说实话，杀死你的，是我的剑，还是我这英俊得没天理的脸？

en: You can plainly see why I am a boss character， and not some lowly thug.
zh: 这下该明白，我为什么是头目，而不是无名小卒了吧。

en: What fool would brandish a sword at one who commands the very fires that made it?
zh: 我连铸剑的烈火都能驾驭，哪个蠢货还敢对我拔剑？

en: You were wise to ally with me!
zh: 与我结盟，果然明智！

en: Ha ha! You will never be worthy， but at least have the dignity not to be worthless.
zh: 哈哈！你永远不够格，但至少要有点骨气，别当个废物。

en: SCANNING... NO THREAT FOUND.
zh: 扫描中……未发现威胁。

en: TARGET OBLITERATED.
zh: 目标已摧毁。

en: TICK TOCK， I JUST CLEANED YOUR CLOCK.
zh: 滴答滴答，你被我打得稀里哗啦。

en: HOSTILE ELEMENTS NEUTRALIZED.
zh: 敌对单位已清除。

en: Big shoulder pads rule!
zh: 大肩甲就是威风！

en: The chicks love me.
zh: 姑娘们都爱我。

en: I don't need any help.
zh: 我不需要任何帮助。

en: That's right， ladies: I'm single!
zh: 没错，女士们，我还是单身！

en: Sorry， friend. Wrong place， wrong time!
zh: 抱歉，朋友。你来错了地方，也赶错了时候！

en: I captain the Red Order... and I champion it!
zh: 我统领红之骑士团……也为它捍卫荣耀！

en: I need more knights who fight like me.
zh: 我需要更多像我这样能打的骑士。

en: Shameful. I would blame your leader， had I seen any leadership.
zh: 丢脸。我本想怪你的首领，可惜没看见半点领导才能。

en: How did I work you? Let me count the ways.
zh: 我是怎么收拾你的？容我一招一招数。

en: I'm like time-- I can't be stopped!
zh: 我就像时间……势不可挡！

en: I just LOVE it when they squirm.
zh: 我就爱看他们挣扎的样子。

en: Roses are red， violets are blue. Sugar is sweet... and I just a-salted you!
zh: 玫瑰红，紫罗兰蓝。糖是甜的……你是咸鱼，我刚给你翻了个面！

en: Admit it， you didn't expect me to win.
zh: 承认吧，你没想到我会赢。

en: I want a raise， a new sword， more rations， and armor that doesn't smell like BO.
zh: 我要加薪、新剑、更多口粮，还有一身没狐臭味的铠甲。

en: I stuck you with the pointy end!
zh: 我用尖尖的那头扎到你了！

en: I hope my boss was watching.
zh: 希望老大刚才看见了。

en: I'm just the cook!
zh: 我只是个厨子！

en: Hi， Mom!
zh: 妈妈，你好！

en: Okay， everyone， look cool!
zh: 好了，各位，摆个帅点的姿势！

en: Chalk one up for the good guys!
zh: 正义一方，再得一分！

en: Kiss my coccyx.
zh: 来亲我的尾骨吧。

en: Got spine?
zh: 有脊梁骨吗？

en: Don't feel bad. It was a “marrow“ defeat.
zh: 别难过。你只是败得有点“骨感”。

en: So， who wants to crack the first “boned“ joke?
zh: 那么，谁先来讲个“骨气全无”的笑话？

en: It's cool to be undead!
zh: 当不死人，真够酷！

en: If it's any consolation， you get to be like me now.
zh: 说个安慰你的消息吧，你现在也能变得跟我一样了。

en: I smell bad!
zh: 我身上好臭！

en: Is that all? Come on， live a little.
zh: 就这？来嘛，活泼点。

en: You'll never guess what I'm wearing under these robes.
zh: 你绝对猜不到，我袍子底下穿了什么。

en: I won all the spelling bees at elementally school.
zh: 我上元素小学时，咒术拼写比赛回回拿冠军。

en: Feckless fools!
zh: 没用的蠢货！

en: Smells like smoke.
zh: 有股烟味。

en: Stop it， you're un-killing me.
zh: 别这样，你都快把我打活了。

en: I can't actually talk. You're hearing things!
zh: 其实我不会说话。你幻听了！

en: Ahem... “Gwaaaaaar!“
zh: 咳……“嘎啊啊啊！”

en: When I find my other arm， I'll really do some damage!
zh: 等我找回另一条胳膊，就真能大杀四方了！

en: Gargoyles know they're cool!
zh: 石像鬼知道自己有多酷！

en: That's nothing compared to what I'm gonna do to you when the screen turns black!
zh: 等屏幕一黑，我要对你做的事，可比这狠多了！

en: I'm a flying rock. Whatchu got?
zh: 我可是会飞的石头。你有什么本事？

en: Crap， my legs fell asleep.
zh: 糟了，我腿麻了。

en: REMATCH? Y/N
zh: 再次对战？是／否

en: DO YOU THINK I AM BORING? Y/N
zh: 你认为我很无聊吗？是／否

en: MISSION COMPLETE. NO LIFE FORMS DETECTED.
zh: 任务完成。未探测到生命体。

en: CONFLICT RESOLVED. AWAITING NEXT COMMAND.
zh: 冲突已解决。等待下一指令。

en: Shoo， fly.
zh: 去，苍蝇，走开。

en: You need to work out more often!
zh: 你该多练练了！

en: Real men fight bare-chested.
zh: 真男人，光膀子打架。

en: Macho bids you greetings from the land of beatings.
zh: 马乔从挨揍之国，向你致以问候。

en: I thought I only pushed dumb-bells around at the gym!
zh: 还以为只有健身房里才要推你这种蠢哑铃呢！

en: Anybody seen my hair gel?
zh: 谁看见我的发胶了？

en: Nice work! It takes skill to lose that badly.
zh: 干得好！输得这么惨，也是种本事。

en: One taste of my brawn， and BAM! They're gone.
zh: 尝过我肌肉的厉害，砰！人就没了。

en: I don't like your tone-- your muscle tone!
zh: 我不喜欢你的状态……肌肉的状态！

en: Somebody get me a mirror so I can watch myself flex!
zh: 谁给我拿面镜子，我要看自己秀肌肉！

en: Aren't you glad I beat those flabby abs into shape?
zh: 我把你那松垮的肚皮揍出了腹肌，你不高兴吗？

en: Let's all go out and grab protein shakes!
zh: 大家一起去喝蛋白奶昔吧！

en: Me take you with eye closed!
zh: 我闭着眼睛也能打败你！

en: Depth perception is overrated.
zh: 什么立体视觉，根本用不着。

en: Me like crush heads.
zh: 我喜欢砸脑袋。

en: Punch， kick， fart， repeat!
zh: 出拳，踢腿，放屁，再来一遍！

en: My brain tickles.
zh: 我脑子痒痒的。

en: The bigger they are， the harder their fists!
zh: 个头越大，拳头越硬！

en: Pick on someone your own size!
zh: 找个跟你一样大的去打！

en: You just got a giant beating!
zh: 你刚挨了一顿巨人揍！

en: You'll make great fertilizer!
zh: 你会是很好的肥料！

en: I eat vegetarians for breakfast!
zh: 吃素的？我早餐就吃你们！

en: Big always wins!
zh: 大块头总会赢！

en: Don't look so crushed.
zh: 别这么垂头丧气，都快被压扁了。

en: Aww. You didn't even try!
zh: 唉，你根本没认真打！

en: “Mid“ is my middle name.
zh: 我中间的名字就叫“米德”。

en: Boooooo-ring.
Gosh， that hardly seemed fair.
zh: 天哪，这好像有点不公平。

en: Mmmmmm... Fresh flesh.
zh: 嗯……新鲜的肉。

en: Consider yourself slain!
zh: 就当你已经死了吧！

en: The sexy fighters always win.
zh: 性感的战士总会赢。

en: I think I've got some YOU stuck in my teeth.
zh: 我牙缝里，好像卡了点你。

en: (Howl!)
zh: （嗷呜！）

en: (Bark! Bark!)
(Sniff sniff! Woof!)
zh: （嗅嗅！汪！）

en: (Growl!)
zh: （呜噜！）

en: How dare you strike a woman! You deserve to lose!
zh: 竟敢打女人！你活该输！

en: I toss a mean salad... just like I tossed you around.
zh: 我拌沙拉可厉害了……就像刚才把你翻来覆去一样。

en: Who says women are the weaker sex?
zh: 谁说女人是弱者？

en: Darn it， I KNEW I made too many sandwiches!
zh: 可恶！我就知道，三明治做多了！

en: Hi， my name is Timmy and I just kicked your butt.
zh: 你好，我叫蒂米，刚把你揍趴下了。

en: Get up! I'm not done playing!
zh: 起来！我还没玩够！

en: Mawwwm! Can I go play on the swing set now?
zh: 妈——！我现在能去荡秋千了吗？

en: Who wants to go buy me some candy?
zh: 谁愿意去给我买点糖？

en: Maybe you oughta be the one collecting pension money.
zh: 也许该去领退休金的人，是你。

en: I can always say I'm tired. What's yer excuse? Hyeh hyeh.
zh: 我还能说自己老了累了。你有什么借口？嘿嘿。

en: Line up， ya rascals， and I'll bend you over my knee!
zh: 排好队，小兔崽子们，让我把你们按在膝盖上打屁股！

en: Respect yer elders， ya derned whipper-snappers!
zh: 尊敬长辈，臭小鬼们！

en: You just lost to the stable boy， horse-face!
zh: 你刚输给了马童，马脸怪！

en: I've only been doing karate for two weeks!
zh: 我才学了两个星期空手道！

en: I wanna learn some spells!
zh: 我想学点法术！

en: Can somebody teach me a combo?
zh: 谁能教我一套连招？

en: Pound for pound， I'm the best fighter there is!
zh: 按体重算，我绝对是最强的战士！

en: Clearly， I'm the best- conditioned athlete here.
zh: 很明显，这里体能最棒的运动员就是我。

en: Hey， let's celebrate! Who wants some chicken nugget and hot fudge pizza!?
zh: 嘿，庆祝一下吧！谁想吃鸡块热巧克力披萨！？

en: Wait a minute... Aren't you in my yoga class?
zh: 等等……你不是我瑜伽班上的同学吗？

en: They call me... the Heck Mech.
zh: 他们叫我……地狱机甲。

en: Why does it say “Made In Taiwan“ on my butt? *Sigh*
zh: 为什么我屁股上写着“台湾制造”？唉。

en: I am well versed in the Art of Gun Fu!
zh: 我深谙枪斗之道！

en: They were an example of inferior craftsmanship.
zh: 他们充分展示了什么叫劣质工艺。

en: Life is good if you're gooey.
zh: 黏糊糊的日子，真不错。

en: Kids love me!
zh: 小孩子都喜欢我！

en: Hey， baby. Wanna e-Lope?
zh: 嘿，宝贝。想跟我私奔吗？

en: I taste like custard. Why did YOU get licked?
zh: 我尝起来像蛋奶酱，你怎么也被舔干净了？

en: There is a fine line between bravery and stupidity--and I just choked you with it.
zh: 勇敢与愚蠢之间，只有一线之隔……而我刚用这条线勒住了你。

en: You have fallen... AND YOU WON'T GET UP!
zh: 你倒下了……再也爬不起来！

en: Insolent fools! No one purges like the Purger!
zh: 放肆的蠢货！论净化，谁也比不过净化者！

en: Nobody believes me when I say I'm the good guy.
zh: 我说自己是好人，可谁都不信。

en: Defeating me will be a greater trial than you can imagine!
zh: 想打败我，远比你想象的艰难！

en: You DARE challenge me!?
zh: 你竟敢挑战我！？

en: With my divine power， victory was preordained!
zh: 凭我的神力，胜利早已注定！

en: Hideous! Is this how you lower-tier creatures fight?
zh: 丑陋！你们这些低等生物，就是这样打架的？

en: If I ever lose， I won't be upset， because I'll be too busy looking good!
zh: 就算输了，我也不会难过。忙着耍帅，哪有空啊！

en: I'm the best， even though my stunt double did all the work!
zh: 就算活儿全是替身干的，我也依旧是最棒的！

en: Hurry up and make me the star of the sequel.
zh: 快点，让我当续作的主角。

en: I know， I know， everyone wants my autograph.
zh: 知道，知道，大家都想要我的签名。

en: I just came to bury the hatchet... in your head.
zh: 我是来冰释前嫌的……先把斧头埋进你脑袋里。

en: You are not fit to polish my axe!
zh: 你连替我擦斧头都不配！

en: Ha! You hit like my squire.
zh: 哈！你这拳头，跟我的侍从差不多。

en: Justice has been done.
zh: 正义已得伸张。

en: You can reach， but you will never touch the sky.
zh: 你尽可伸手，却永远触不到天空。

en: I have a name. You're just not worthy of knowing it.
zh: 我有名字。只是你不配知道。

en: I am the ultimate warrior. You were ultimately nothing.
zh: 我是终极战士，而你终究一无是处。

en: One of me is worth 100 of you.
zh: 我一个，抵得上你们一百个。

en: And I was just warming up.
zh: 而我才刚热身。

en: The blessings of the earth belong to the strong alone!
zh: 大地的恩赐，只属于强者！

en: What stupidity! Learn to respect power beyond your own!
zh: 真愚蠢！学会敬畏远胜于自己的力量吧！

en: There's a name for those who fight like you. I believe we call them... losers!
zh: 你这种打法，我们有个专门的称呼。好像叫……废物！

en: Is this some sort of joke?
zh: 这是在开玩笑吗？

en: Foolish mortal， you amuse me!
zh: 愚蠢的凡人，你逗乐我了！

en: You are not fit to kiss the ground I rule over!
zh: 我统治的土地，你连亲吻它的资格都没有！

en: Oh dear... I've broken another one.
zh: 哎呀……又弄坏一个。

en: I could have beaten you with patches over both eyes!
zh: 就算两只眼睛都蒙上，我也能打败你！

en: What sort of embarrassing performance was that?
zh: 你刚才那是什么丢脸的表演？

en: I was born to lead.
zh: 我生来就是领袖。

en: Save the swelled head for when you become a swell fighter.
zh: 等你真有本事了，再来这么自大吧。

en: YOU WILL NEVER CATCH ME， COPPER.
zh: 条子，你永远抓不到我。

en: MY ORBS FLICKER FOR YOU.
zh: 我的光球，为你闪烁。

en: TARGET ERADICATED.
zh: 目标已清除。

en: CHASSIS OVERHEATED. ENTERING COOLDOWN CYCLE.
zh: 机体过热。进入冷却循环。

en: You know， you really--what's the word--suck.
zh: 你知道吗，你真是……那词怎么说来着……烂透了。

en: Ahem. “Gwaaaaaar!“
zh: 咳。“嘎啊啊啊！”

en: I toss a rag doll... just like I tossed you around.
zh: 我能把布娃娃甩来甩去……就像刚才甩你一样。
